messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "may eat, drink, or take other oral medicines after 30 minutes of taking the tablet"
set: ["may eat, drink, or take other oral medicines after 30 minutes of taking the tablet", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "take at least 30 minutes before first food, beverage, or other oral medications of the day", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "if child vomits within 30 minutes after taking, take another dose", "do not take after 30 weeks of pregnancy", "taken 30 minutes before the start of single-day HEC", "15 to 30 minutes", "oral granules should be taken 30 minutes before a meal", "first dose given 30 minutes before the start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "do not crush, chew, or break the tablet or oral granules", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "first dose administered 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin",
    "take at least 30 minutes before first food, beverage, or other oral medications of the day",
    "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day",
    "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy",
    "if child vomits within 30 minutes after taking, take another dose",
    "taken 30 minutes before the start of single-day HEC",
    "first dose given 30 minutes before the start of emetogenic chemotherapy",
    "first dose administered 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy",
    "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC"
  ],
  "alias": "take at least 30 minutes before first food, beverage, or other oral medications of the day"
}
